answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via Proof of Burn. Before trading at a settlement wharf, an agent sends tokens to a provably unspendable address and submits a Merkle inclusion proof. Verifiers inspect each credential through an age-weighted prism to prevent burst registrations. Attackers incur the verifiable cost of permanently destroying scarce capital per identity. However, sunk costs block low-budget agents while wealthy adversaries can still buy identities like rare jade.
